_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for tax-year figures. Pages reference keys via <Figure id="..."/>. Update here each fall when the IRS releases inflation adjustments; every page updates. Each entry: value, taxYear, source (Rev. Proc. / IRC / IRS page), verified (date).

oic.application_fee.source: IRS Offer in Compromise page and Form 656-B booklet

ia.setup_fee.online_directdebit.source: IRS Payment plans (installment agreements) page, updated 2026-03-03; ceiling set by Reg. § 300.1(b)

ia.setup_fee.online_other.source: IRS Payment plans (installment agreements) page, updated 2026-03-03; ceiling set by Reg. § 300.1(b)

ia.setup_fee.phone_mail_directdebit.source: IRS Payment plans (installment agreements) page, updated 2026-03-03; ceiling set by Reg. § 300.1(b)

ia.setup_fee.phone_mail_other.source: IRS Payment plans (installment agreements) page, updated 2026-03-03; ceiling set by Reg. § 300.1(b)

ia.setup_fee.lowincome.value: waived with direct debit; $43 otherwise, reimbursed on completion
ia.setup_fee.lowincome.source: IRS Payment plans (installment agreements) page, updated 2026-03-03; ceiling set by Reg. § 300.1(b); IRC § 6159(f)

penalty.ftf.rate.value: 5% of the tax per month or part month, maximum 25%

penalty.ftp.rate.value: 0.5% of the tax per month or part month, maximum 25%

penalty.ftf.minimum.value: the lesser of $535 or 100% of the tax required to be shown, for returns required to be filed in 2027
penalty.ftf.minimum.source: IRC § 6651(a) flush language and § 6651(j); Rev. Proc. 2025-32 § 3.52

penalty.fraud.rate.value: 75% of the underpayment attributable to fraud

preparer.6694a.value: the greater of $1,000 or 50% of the income derived or to be derived from the return or claim

preparer.6694b.value: the greater of $5,000 or 75% of the income derived or to be derived from the return or claim

sol.assessment.general.value: 3 years from the later of the due date or the date filed

sol.assessment.substantial_omission.value: 6 years (omission exceeding 25% of the gross income stated on the return)

sol.refund.general.value: later of 3 years from filing or 2 years from payment

efile.mandate_threshold.value: 11 or more covered returns in the calendar year

ea.ce.hours_per_cycle.value: 72 hours per 3-year cycle, min 16 per year incl. 2 ethics

ia.short_term.fee.source: IRS Payment plans (installment agreements) page, updated 2026-03-03; ceiling set by Reg. § 300.1(b)

ia.short_term.max_days.source: IRS Payment plans (installment agreements) page, updated 2026-03-03; ceiling set by Reg. § 300.1(b)

ia.simple.threshold.value: $50,000 or less aggregate unpaid balance of assessment

oic.lump_sum_initial.value: 20% of the total offer, with the application
oic.lump_sum_initial.source: IRS Offer in Compromise page and Form 656-B booklet; IRC § 7122(c)(1)(A)

oic.lump_sum_max_payments.source: IRS Offer in Compromise page and Form 656-B booklet; IRC § 7122(c)(1)(A)(ii)

preparer.6695.per_failure.value: $65 per return or claim, capped at $33,000
preparer.6695.per_failure.source: Rev. Proc. 2025-32 § 3.54 (returns or claims filed in 2027); IRC § 6695(a)–(e)

preparer.6695f.check.source: Rev. Proc. 2025-32 § 3.54 (returns or claims filed in 2027); IRC § 6695(f)

preparer.6695g.duediligence.source: Rev. Proc. 2025-32 § 3.54 (returns or claims filed in 2027); IRC § 6695(g)

preparer.6694a.assessment_period.value: 3 years from the filing of the return or claim

preparer.6694b.assessment_period.value: no limitation period — assessable at any time

preparer.stay_of_collection.value: 15% of the penalty, paid within 30 days of notice and demand, with a refund claim

penalty.accuracy.gross_valuation.value: 40% of the underpayment attributable to a gross valuation misstatement

penalty.substantial_understatement.thres.value: an understatement exceeding the greater of 10% of the tax required to be shown or $5,000 (corporations: the lesser of the greater of 10% or $10,000, or $10,000,000)

penalty.frivolous.value: $5,000 per frivolous return or specified frivolous submission

preparer.6701.individual.value: $1,000 per document, and only one penalty per person per taxpayer per taxable period

preparer.6701.corporate.value: $10,000 per document where the document relates to a corporation's tax liability

preparer.6713.per_disclosure.value: $250 per disclosure or use, capped at $10,000 per calendar year

preparer.7216.criminal.value: a misdemeanor: a fine of up to $1,000, imprisonment of up to one year, or both, plus costs of prosecution

penalty.valuation.thresholds.value: substantial at 150% or more of the correct value or adjusted basis; gross at 200% or more

preparer.6695B.assessment_period.value: 6 years from the filing of the return or claim

preparer.6713.assessment_period.value: no limitation period — § 6696(d) does not reach § 6713

preparer.refund_claim_period.value: 3 years from the date the penalty was paid

preparer.suit_window.value: 30 days after the earlier of denial of the refund claim or the expiration of 6 months from filing it

preparer.consent_windows.value: a consent is sought when under 180 days remain, and must be obtained if the case goes to Appeals with under 365 days remaining
